title: DSW-C30-MARGIN96: lower classical-memory windowed dissection with linear quantum space

claims.statement: For every N>=2 and s in Z/NZ, n=ceil(log2 N), the single DSW-C30-MARGIN96 algorithm/configuration of proof.md (finite exhaustive branch below n=2^32768; otherwise r=ceil(sqrt n), U=least nonnegative integer with U^100>=n^49, t=floor(r/10)-16U, w=3t, y1=ceil(3t/2), y4=ceil(3t/10), y7=ceil(193r/400), binary/four/seven-input measured-window dissection with physical flag/rank/block merges, fixed acquisition/demand/listing caps and physical odd/two-adic decoding) recovers the ENTIRE secret with unconditional probability at least 1-2^-8 from independent ideal copies. On EVERY execution branch, including failed merges, wrong label estimates, discards and cap aborts, total charged sequential work obeys T=O(2^[(108787/54000)sqrt(n)-96 n^(49/100)]), with an absolute constant. The displayed uniform bit-length envelope has growth index exactly 1/2. This holds JOINTLY with the other three resource bounds and the same complete success guarantee; the literal coefficients, negative correction and outside polynomial factor are exactly those in the structured object. Proof Sections 2-10 establish the physical algorithm and native ledger; Section 11 derives this exact envelope.
